headline: Approval of Collective Bargaining Agreement for Pawtucket Teachers Alliance and contract with Amerigis Educational Staffing.
summary: The agenda includes a vote on the Pawtucket Teachers Alliance contract and a contract with Amerigis Educational Staffing. It also covers school opening readiness, school facility updates, and the 2027 meeting schedule.
items: Possible executive session on the Teachers Alliance contract, job performance of District employees, and potential litigation
Vote on whether to approve the collective bargaining agreement for the Pawtucket Teachers Alliance
Superintendent's report: 2026/2027 school opening and District readiness
Superintendent's report: overview of before and after school programs
Superintendent's report: school leadership preparation and professional learning
Superintendent's report: Right to Read Act implementation update
Discussion: RIDE presentation on School Housing Aid and Revolving Fund
Discussion: PSD capital reserve balance update
Discussion: Slater Middle School facilities status update
Discussion: Baldwin Elementary School facility update
Discussion and action: 2027 Pawtucket School Committee meeting schedule
Discussion and action: approval of contract with Amerigis Educational Staffing
Subcommittee updates: Building, Facilities, Finance, Policy, Special Education, and Wellness
Reports: budget transfer, departmental overtime, enrollment, monthly distribution, vacancy, and work order
location: Lyman B. Goff Middle School, 974 Newport Avenue, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02861
